road_driving_subset.scope: GT lexical/number extraction proxies; agreement is not absolute semantic correctness

quality.repeated_quality_scope: Round 0 = primary unique quality set. Repeats are paired stability checks, not additional independent questions.

signals.attribution_scope: Observed groups are descriptive; only counterfactual planner changes assess decision sensitivity.

primary_reuse_statistics.cache_update_scope: CPU enqueue only; GPU clone/update included in measured prefill, not separately isolated

limitations: Few scene clusters; percentile intervals are descriptive and do not establish population safety.
Only short natural consecutive scene segments; no claim of complete-scene evaluation.
Quality labels are lexical proxies, not human semantic correctness.
M3 native timing is summed native generation wall per frame; WSDR timing is whole runtime wall.
Read-only tracing adds scalar metadata bookkeeping to WSDR measurement; no extra model forwards.
Offline counterfactuals change planner signals only, with fixed observed overhead; not accuracy/speed evidence.
Non-reuse requests and every repeat retained; repeated questions do not multiply quality N.

percentile_changes_by_repeat.scope: Differences of paired-workload marginal percentiles; not percentiles of paired deltas
Differences of paired-workload marginal percentiles; not percentiles of paired deltas

quality_evidence_status.interpretation: A missing profile interval is insufficient evidence, not an observed quality-budget violation
quality_evidence_status.zero_difference_interval_limit: Identical paired scores give a degenerate empirical bootstrap interval; this does not bound unseen error probability

acceptance_answers.paper_readiness: Limited independent evidence only; expand unique scenes, task-quality samples and repeated latency evidence before broad paper claims
